verse.name: v1
verse.lines:
AYI Yesu-ow'ekisa
Ggwe bulamu-obw'abantu,
Omutonzi wa byonna,
Otuwulire.

verse.name: v2
verse.lines:
Ebibi bwe byabunya
Ku bantu bonna-okufa
Ggwe eyabalokola,
Otusonyiwe.

verse.name: v3
verse.lines:
Ggwe-eyalinnya mu ggulu
-Okulya-obwakabaka bwo,
Mukama w'abakama,
Otuwulire.

verse.name: v4
verse.lines:
Ggwe-olikomawo nate
Okusala-omusango
Gw'abalamu n'abafu,
Otulokole
